questions.stem: 用植物肉取代牛肉可以減少養牛產生的溫室氣體，進而減緩全球暖化。
questions.answer: Replacing beef with plant-based meat can reduce the greenhouse gases produced by raising cattle, helping to slow down global warming.
accepted_answers: Using plant-based meat in place of beef can cut down on the greenhouse gases that come from raising cows, slowing down global warming.
Eating plant-based meat instead of beef can reduce the greenhouse gases released by cattle farming, helping to slow global warming.

patterns: 句尾分詞片語表結果（…，進而減緩全球暖化）
動名詞片語當主詞（用植物肉取代牛肉）

questions.stem: 然而，相較於一般牛肉，植物肉的價格仍然偏高，消費者是否願意購買還很難說。
questions.answer: However, compared with regular beef, plant-based meat is still more expensive, so it is hard to say whether consumers will buy it.
accepted_answers: However, compared to ordinary beef, plant-based meat still costs more, and it is still hard to tell whether consumers are willing to buy it.
However, in comparison with regular beef, the price of plant-based meat is still higher, so it is difficult to say whether consumers will pay for it.

patterns: 間接問句（whether 名詞子句：消費者是否願意購買）
相較於…（比較片語＋比較級：相較於一般牛肉，…仍然偏高）

1.explanation_zh: 主詞是「用植物肉取代牛肉」這個動作，寫成動名詞片語 Replacing beef with plant-based meat；注意 replace A with B 是「用 B 取代 A」，被換掉的 beef 放在前面。「養牛產生的溫室氣體」修飾語較長，英文放到名詞後面：the greenhouse gases produced by raising cattle（cattle 是集合名詞，不加 s）。「進而減緩全球暖化」是前面減碳帶來的結果，用句尾分詞 helping to slow down global warming。
1.strategy_zh: 先寫主幹 V-ing … can reduce + N；再把「養牛產生的」移到名詞後面；最後用 helping to … 接上結果。
hints: 切成四段：用植物肉取代牛肉／可以減少／養牛產生的溫室氣體／進而減緩全球暖化
標的詞彙：replace（取代）、beef（牛肉）、reduce（減少）、greenhouse（溫室）、cattle（牛隻）
句型框架：Replacing A with B + can + VR + N + p.p. …, helping to VR …

2.explanation_zh: 「相較於一般牛肉」用 compared with／to regular beef，後面的主要子句要有比較級：plant-based meat is still more expensive（或 still costs more）。注意「價格偏高」若以 price 當主詞要說 the price is higher，不說 the price is expensive。「消費者是否願意購買還很難說」英文用 it is hard to say whether consumers will buy it，whether 子句用直述句語序。
evidence: 植物肉的價格仍然偏高
消費者是否願意購買還很難說
2.strategy_zh: 比較片語放句首，主要子句一定要出現比較級；後半句先寫 it is hard to say，再接 whether 子句。
hints: 切成四段：相較於一般牛肉／植物肉的價格仍然偏高／消費者是否願意購買／還很難說
標的詞彙：compare（比較）、expensive（昂貴的）、consumer（消費者）、hard（困難的）
句型框架：Compared with + N, S + be + 比較級 …, so it is hard to say whether + S + V …

references: Replacing beef with plant-based meat can reduce the greenhouse gases produced by raising cattle, helping to slow down global warming.
Using plant-based meat in place of beef can cut down on the greenhouse gases that come from raising cows, slowing down global warming.
Eating plant-based meat instead of beef can reduce the greenhouse gases released by cattle farming, helping to slow global warming.

target_words.zh: 牛隻（集合名詞，視為複數）

patterns.label_zh: 句尾分詞片語表結果（…，進而減緩全球暖化）
動名詞片語當主詞（用植物肉取代牛肉）
patterns.frame: V-ing A with B … + can + VR …

accepted: Using plant-based meat in place of beef
Eating plant-based meat instead of beef
Using plant-based meat instead of beef
Using plant-based meat to replace beef
Replacing beef with meat made from plants

common_errors.explanation_zh: replace A with B 是「用 B 取代 A」，被換掉的牛肉要緊接在 replace 後面。

common_errors.wrong: Use plant-based meat to replace beef can reduce
common_errors.right: Using plant-based meat to replace beef can reduce
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動詞片語當主詞要改成動名詞（或不定詞）。
reduce 本身就是「減少」，後面不加 down；cut 才說 cut down on。
less 是形容詞或副詞，不能當動詞；「減少」用 reduce／cut down on。

accepted: the greenhouse gases produced by raising cattle
the greenhouse gases that come from raising cows
the greenhouse gases released by cattle farming
the greenhouse gases produced by raising cows
greenhouse gas emissions from cattle farming

common_errors.wrong: the raising cattle produced greenhouse gases
common_errors.right: the greenhouse gases produced by raising cattle
common_errors.explanation_zh: 中文的修飾語放在名詞前；英文較長的修飾語要放到名詞後面（分詞片語或關係子句）。

common_errors.wrong: the greenhouse gases produced by raising cattles
common_errors.right: the greenhouse gases produced by raising cattle
common_errors.explanation_zh: cattle 本身就是複數意義的集合名詞，不加 s。

accepted: helping to slow down global warming

common_errors.wrong: , helps to slow down global warming
common_errors.right: , helping to slow down global warming
common_errors.explanation_zh: 逗號後直接接動詞會變成沒有主詞的子句；表結果用分詞 helping。
「全球暖化」是固定名詞 global warming。

traps.literal_error: Replacing plant-based meat with beef can reduce the greenhouse gases produced by raising cattle.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文是「用 B 取代 A」，英文要寫 replace A with B（或 use B instead of A）；照中文語序寫成 replace B with A，意思剛好相反。

traps.literal_error: can reduce the raising cattle produced greenhouse gases
traps.explanation_zh: 中文把「養牛產生的」放在名詞前面；英文要把修飾語移到 gases 後面，寫成 produced by raising cattle 或 that come from raising cattle。

bonus.text: Were more people to replace beef with plant-based meat, far less greenhouse gas would be released, which would help slow down global warming.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用省略 if 的假設倒裝 Were + S + to VR 表示「要是更多人…」的假設情境；題目本身不是假設語氣，只當加分寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 「用植物肉取代牛肉」整個動作當主詞，英文寫成動名詞片語，並改用 replace A with B 的語序；「養牛產生的溫室氣體」的前置修飾語要移到名詞後面（produced by raising cattle）；「進而…」改成句尾分詞 helping to … 表結果。

references: However, compared with regular beef, plant-based meat is still more expensive, so it is hard to say whether consumers will buy it.
However, compared to ordinary beef, plant-based meat still costs more, and it is still hard to tell whether consumers are willing to buy it.
However, in comparison with regular beef, the price of plant-based meat is still higher, so it is difficult to say whether consumers will pay for it.

patterns.label_zh: 間接問句（whether 名詞子句：消費者是否願意購買）
patterns.frame: it is hard to say + whether + S + V（直述句語序）

patterns.label_zh: 相較於…（比較片語＋比較級：相較於一般牛肉，…仍然偏高）
patterns.frame: Compared with + N, S + be + 比較級 …

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「相較於」用過去分詞片語 compared with／to，不能用原形 compare。
植物肉是「被拿來比較」的一方，用過去分詞 compared。

parts.zh: 植物肉的價格仍然偏高
accepted: plant-based meat is still more expensive
the price of plant-based meat is still higher
plant-based meat is still more costly
plant-based meat is still relatively expensive

common_errors.wrong: the price of plant-based meat is still more expensive
common_errors.right: the price of plant-based meat is still higher
common_errors.explanation_zh: price 只能說 high／low；expensive 用來形容東西本身（plant-based meat is more expensive）。

common_errors.right: plant-based meat is still more expensive
common_errors.explanation_zh: expensive 是多音節形容詞，比較級用 more expensive。

accepted: whether consumers are willing to buy it
whether consumers will pay for it
whether consumers are willing to pay for it

common_errors.explanation_zh: 間接問句用直述句語序：whether + 主詞 + 動詞。

common_errors.wrong: whether consumers are willing to buy
common_errors.right: whether consumers are willing to buy it
common_errors.explanation_zh: buy 是及物動詞，要補受詞 it（指植物肉）。

accepted: it is still hard to tell
it is still difficult to say

common_errors.wrong: it is hard to say that
common_errors.right: it is hard to say whether
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「…還很難說」是不確定的事，後面接 whether／if 子句，不接 that。
「很難說」是「很難斷定」，用 hard to say／hard to tell；speak 是「說話、講話」。

traps.literal_error: the price of plant-based meat is still more expensive
traps.explanation_zh: 「價格高」英文說 the price is high；expensive 用來形容東西本身，不說 the price is expensive。

traps.zh: 消費者是否願意購買還很難說
traps.literal_error: Consumers whether are willing to buy it is still hard to say.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文拿整個「消費者是否願意購買」當主詞；英文要改成 whether 名詞子句，習慣寫成 It is hard to say whether …，子句內用直述句語序。

bonus.text: However, plant-based meat still costs more than regular beef, and only time will tell whether consumers are willing to pay for it.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 only time will tell（只有時間能證明）表達「還很難說」，比較的對象改用 than 直接帶出。

2.restructuring_zh: 「消費者是否願意購買還很難說」中文以問句當主詞，英文習慣改成 it is hard to say whether …，把 whether 子句放到句尾。

1.translation: Replacing beef with plant-based meat can reduce the greenhouse gases produced by raising cattle, thus slowing down global warming.
1.explanation_zh: 動名詞片語當主詞；replace A with B 要注意 A 是被取代的牛肉；「養牛產生的」用過去分詞片語 produced by raising cattle 後位修飾；「進而減緩」是結果，用句尾分詞 thus slowing down。

2.translation: However, compared with regular beef, plant-based meat is still relatively expensive, so it is hard to say whether consumers will be willing to buy it.
2.explanation_zh: 「相較於」用分詞片語 compared with；「價格偏高」直接說 relatively expensive，避免 the price is expensive 的搭配錯誤；兩個子句用 so 連接，避免逗號接句；「是否…還很難說」用 whether 名詞子句當 say 的受詞。

issues_zh: 參考譯文 2「in comparison with regular beef, the price of plant-based meat is still higher」比較的對象不對稱：拿「一般牛肉」和「植物肉的價格」比，嚴格說要寫 compared with that of regular beef，或改成 plant-based meat is still more expensive。第 2 部分 accepted 的 the price of plant-based meat is still higher 和第 1 部分的 compared with regular beef 組起來也是同樣的問題。這一句的常見錯誤正好在教「price 和 expensive 的搭配」，範句本身最好也示範對稱的比較。

1.translation: Replacing beef with plant-based meat can reduce the greenhouse gases produced by raising cattle, thus slowing down global warming.
1.explanation_zh: 「用 A 取代 B」譯為 replace B with A（用植物肉取代牛肉＝replace beef with plant-based meat），動名詞當主詞；「養牛產生的溫室氣體」用過去分詞後置修飾；「進而減緩全球暖化」用 thus + 現在分詞表示結果。

2.translation: However, compared with regular beef, plant-based meat is still relatively expensive, and it is hard to say whether consumers will be willing to buy it.
2.explanation_zh: 「相較於」用 compared with；「價格偏高」直接說 relatively expensive 比 the price is high 自然；「是否願意購買還很難說」用虛主詞 it is hard to say whether …。

issues_zh: 「仍然偏高」我自然譯成 relatively expensive（第 2 部分的 accepted 也收這個寫法），句中沒有比較級，所以 COMP（Compared with + N, S + be + 比較級）只用到 compared with 的開頭，比較級沒被引出；中文沒有逼人用 more expensive／higher。
第 2 部分的 accepted 收了 relatively expensive，目標卻標 COMP，標記前後不一致：學生寫這個寫法可以拿到該部分的分數，卻沒練到比較級。建議中文改成更明確的比較（例如「比一般牛肉貴」），或把 relatively expensive 從 accepted 拿掉。
